allow: Bash(which godot || which godot4 || godot --version 2>/dev/null || echo "Godot not found")
Bash(apt-get install -y godot3 2>/dev/null || echo "Not in apt"; snap install godot-4 2>/dev/null || echo "snap not available")
Bash(apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y wget python3 python3-pip unzip 2>&1 | tail -5)
Bash(apk update -q && apk add --no-cache wget unzip python3 py3-pip 2>&1 | tail -5)
Bash(apk add --no-cache py3-docx 2>/dev/null; python3 -c "import docx" 2>/dev/null && echo "docx available" || pip3 install python-docx -q && echo "installed")
